declarations.name: AuiRecurrencePicker
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI RecurrencePicker: `<aui-recurrence-picker>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Legend of the fieldset (required accessible name).

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the legend; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: Series start: defaults, the minimum end date, and the preview.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name of the hidden input (iCalendar text).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text referenced by the fieldset.

inputs.name: firstDayOfWeek
inputs.description: First weekday toggle. Default: the locale's first day of week.

inputs.name: previewCount
inputs.description: Next occurrences listed under the summary (needs start); 0 hides the preview.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Month and weekday names, dates, numbers, the first day of the week, and messages.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: Timezone of the start wall-clock time, the preview, and UNTIL.

inputs.name: disambiguation
inputs.description: DST policy for wall-clock times in a gap or overlap (SPEC section 8.5).

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Reading direction; Left/Right arrow keys and chevrons follow it.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the rule or its validity error.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: iCalendar text, or null when not repeating or invalid.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear state (no events).

accessibility.pattern: A fieldset of native form controls (select, number inputs, radio groups, toggle buttons) with a legend, a live summary, and a list of next occurrences.

limitations: Controls cover one day of month or one nth weekday per month; other rules (several month days, BYSETPOS, several months) are kept as "Custom" and cannot be edited in place.
No hourly or minute frequencies; the time of day comes from the series start.
EXDATE/RDATE are preserved but not edited here.
The end date is always a date (no end time).
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
